video_title: BREAKING: NBA Hands Down Historic Punishments in Kawhi Leonard Saga (ft. Pablo Torre)

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' salary cap circumvention involved fake consulting jobs for four companies
quotes.excerpt: This was not merely a story of fake jobs for Kawhi Leonard. This was a story of fake consulting jobs.
quotes.quote: This was not merely a story of fake jobs for Kawhi Leonard. This was a story of fake consulting jobs for the four companies that Wachtell Lipton detailed in documentation. Everybody got fake jobs and the contracts to build out the Intuit Dome with the wireless sponsor, the insurance provider, the scoreboard maker, the carbon credit environmental company, that all went to the two billion dollar building that Steve Ballmer is now banned from for a year. All of those deals, according to our reporting and now the NBA's investigation, were contingent on paying Kawhi Leonard in ways they weren't allowed to do.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Lawrence Frank took contemporaneous notes during meetings about prohibited activities
quotes.excerpt: Lawrence Frank was taking contemporaneous notes during meetings that were about the things they were not allowed to do.
quotes.quote: Lawrence Frank, the GM of the Clippers, the president of basketball operations, was taking contemporaneous notes during meetings that were about the things they were not allowed to do. And those notes were quoted by Wachtell Lipton, and they praised Lawrence Frank, who got a four-year extension from the Clippers in December of last year, by the way, mid-investigation. Lawrence Frank had notes quoting Steve Ballmer about how Ballmer pledged to Uncle Dennis Robertson and Kawhi Leonard, we are going to act as collective workers to your financial benefit. That was quoted from Lawrence Frank's notes.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer was a participant and overseer of the Clippers' salary cap scheme
quotes.excerpt: It is very clear that Steve Ballmer was a participant and the overseer of a GM and a head of business.
quotes.quote: It is very clear that Steve Ballmer was a participant and the overseer of a GM and a head of business that were operating in a scheme. This was a scheme. It was a scheme with four separate companies and beyond, according to my reporting, by the way. There are some names in here that didn't make it in that we will get to eventually. But this is Ballmer's quotes, his authorization, his investments, his oversight. And anybody who knows, as we've said from the beginning, that the dude was measuring the distance between toilets in his building, he knows that the details matter. He was a recidivist.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer funneled money through partners to pay for Clippers' expenses
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer was directly funneling money through sponsors. It's just that he did it in a way that the NBA called novel.
quotes.quote: Steve Ballmer was directly funneling money through sponsors. It's just that he did it in a way that the NBA called novel that the Clippers thought would be their excuse. We're going to do it through partners that we will pay as a team for the $100 million video board, for locked-in insurance, the insurance company on the construction, for Boingo Wireless. I didn't have this on my Boingo card, Dan. The wireless company would be a key player in this.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Gillian Zucker created a manufactured paper trail to hide Clippers' activities
quotes.excerpt: She created, according to the NBA, a manufactured paper trail to hide what they were doing.
quotes.quote: She created, according to the NBA, a manufactured paper trail to hide what they were doing so that when investigators or journalists came looking, they could say, we had an introductory email and we were off to the races. Which is what Steve Ballmer said to Ramona Shelburne when he came onto ESPN air a day after we dropped part one as his exculpatory proof.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard settled, making it impossible for the Clippers to seek arbitration
quotes.excerpt: Part A, for people who haven't been keeping track, is now impossible according to the CBA. Kawhi Leonard settled.
quotes.quote: Part A, for people who haven't been keeping track, is now impossible according to the CBA. Why? Kawhi Leonard settled. The union settled. Everything we've heard in ESPN especially was the union will never settle. They'll never settle, they'll never settle. Kawhi Leonard got a slap on the wrist. He settled. What does that mean? The Clippers can't take this to arbitration. They now need to sue in court. The NBA and Wachtell Lipton and maybe us, if they want. But they need to figure out how they're going to explain this to a jury.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA lawyers used a savvy legal strategy to box in Steve Ballmer
quotes.excerpt: That is a very savvy legal move that the NBA's lawyers made to box in Steve Ballmer.
quotes.quote: That is a very savvy legal move that the NBA's lawyers made to box in Steve Ballmer. That is my read based on the report.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: The Raptors are waiting to see if the Clippers' trade is finalized
quotes.excerpt: We're waiting for the trade to go through. And by the way, the Raptors now are thinking to themselves, is it done?
quotes.quote: We're waiting for the trade to go through. And by the way, the Raptors now are thinking to themselves, is it done? And I keep saying to everybody, it's not done. But they are thinking to themselves, maybe it's done. And that's how the Clippers get those picks back.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Gillian Zucker is the right-hand person of Steve Ballmer
quotes.excerpt: She is the right-hand person of Steve Ballmer. What Lawrence Frank is to basketball operations, she is to business.
quotes.quote: She is the right-hand person of Steve Ballmer. What Lawrence Frank is to basketball operations, she is to business. She is the character that we introduced in our series that was across that Dectronics stuff. She was on emails with Joe Sambur, the co-founder of Aspiration. She's the person who was there to execute what Ballmer wanted.

quotes.speaker: Steve Ballmer
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer claims he was defrauded by his own employees
quotes.excerpt: These are guys who committed fraud. How would I be able... Look, they conned me.
quotes.quote: These are guys who committed fraud. How would I be able... Look, they conned me. I made an investment in these guys thinking it was on the up and up and they conned me. At this stage, I have no ability to predict why they might have done anything they did.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' attempts to sell a false story failed due to evidence
quotes.excerpt: They have tried to sell a story in which I and we have been lying about this the whole time.
quotes.quote: For a year, the Clippers, through their personal relationships with media, with crisis PR people, with compliant outlets, have tried to sell a story in which I and we have been lying about this the whole time. And what those media sources should have known a lot earlier than yesterday was that it was the opposite. They were being fed a story that could not be rationally explained and for a year we asked for the explanation and it never came. And so two weeks ago, when ESPN goes with that story, all I could think was it felt like people who were trying to compete on a story that they got beat on without doing the work.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: CBA protects players while allowing the NBA to punish owners
quotes.excerpt: The CBA is a fascinating collectively bargained document that is bargained between owners and players.
quotes.quote: The CBA is a fascinating collectively bargained document that is bargained between owners and players. And so the players in that document have a level of protection by the NBA's rules that is special and is, it turns out, something that can be used to box in the richest owner in American sports, Steve Ballmer, if the commissioner and if the other owners deem that richest owner in American sports, Steve Ballmer, to be acting beyond what is acceptable to them.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers ignored repeated warnings and believed they were smarter than everyone else
quotes.excerpt: The Clippers were warned repeatedly what they should not do and they thought they were smarter than everybody.
quotes.quote: The Clippers were warned repeatedly what they should not do and they thought they were smarter than everybody. And they said, all we got to do is make a fake paper trail, never thinking that the real paper trail would be acknowledged. They said, all we got to do is stay within the letter of a law that we have misinterpreted and these journalists can't touch us. All they got to do is say the story is A to all of the reporters that we look into the eyes and lie to and we can get away with it, never thinking that story B, the truth, would ever be attested to by sources brave enough to say it.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer introduced Gillian Zucker as his right-hand person
quotes.excerpt: I've been saying it's Gillian Zucker and then David, it's like if I pronounce a Filipino name one way.
quotes.quote: I've been saying it's Gillian Zucker and then David, it's like if I pronounce a Filipino name one way, you're going to trust my pronunciation of it. David just goes to Zucker and I'm like, I guess it must be Zucker. So, I apologize for that.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' executives prepared for exit while others faced consequences
quotes.excerpt: I think one of those people in Lawrence Frank prepared for an exit, the other one, Gillian Zucker.
quotes.quote: I think one of those people in Lawrence Frank prepared for an exit, the other one, Gillian Zucker, in her non-compliance with the NBA investigation, perhaps knew that she didn't have a backup quite as good. And that was a calculation that we are only, based on the available reporting, connecting the dots on, but that's what it feels like to me.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Gillian Zucker and Lawrence Frank likely won't keep their jobs
quotes.excerpt: If I'm taking a guess, I don't think Gillian Zucker or Lawrence Frank keep their jobs.
quotes.quote: If I'm taking a guess, I don't think Gillian Zucker or Lawrence Frank keep their jobs. And that's even before you get to the particular hypothetical betrayal that Ballmer might feel on the part of either of them.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' consulting jobs were fake and lacked real responsibility
quotes.excerpt: All of these jobs effectively were fake jobs. Wachtell tested to that.
quotes.quote: All of these jobs effectively were fake jobs. Wachtell tested to that. These were jobs with minimal responsibilities in which he did virtually nothing outside of an autograph signing for Boingo Wireless at an army base, which we've been reporting, by the way, in ways that we got scooped on unfortunately. But that was the one thing. These were all fake jobs. We've been saying it. Why would you do any of this if they weren't fake jobs? They were all fake jobs and even more fake jobs than we realized.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' salary cap scheme remains the only precedent for Clippers' punishment
quotes.excerpt: The Timberwolves is the only precedent, but as we have been saying, the Timberwolves was a promise.
quotes.quote: The Timberwolves is the only precedent, but as we have been saying, the Timberwolves was a promise from an owner to an agent that was locked in a drawer that got loosed by a dispute within the agency. This was a vast scheme that involves federal agencies that is not over yet. So, precedent is the T-Wolves, the story is multiples more than what the T-Wolves actually did.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard regrets lapses made by people in his inner circle
quotes.excerpt: One of the funniest quotes is that he regrets the lapses made by people in his inner circle.
quotes.quote: One of the funniest quotes is that he regrets the lapses made by people in his inner circle. Peace out, I'm going to Toronto. If you read that and you happen to be Steve Ballmer, you are punching a hole in your wall because that's the same guy you needed to go to war against the league with you, and that guy did what he's done this entire story, which is prioritize his self-interest over the collective good of the team, and you're left holding multiple bags.

quotes.speaker: Pablo Torre
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA chose an end-around to avoid Clippers' consent requirement
quotes.excerpt: What the NBA wound up doing was an end-around, an end-around around the Clippers needing to consent.
quotes.quote: What the NBA wound up doing was an end-around, an end-around around the Clippers needing to consent. When the Clippers signaled that they were going to fight till the very end, the NBA knew, okay, we're in water time and we have an arsenal of evidence. So how do we handle it? And they figured out if the union participates and settles, we don't need Ballmer.
